outer_fold: LOPO cristobalite_beta; source phases quartz_beta and tridymite_p63mmc
physical_reference_layer: frozen archived processed reference_G; fixed pressure and shared quartz gauge; do not refit target labels
temperature_support: Intersection of frozen reference and C prediction support: 1649 integer temperatures, 851–2499 K; preserve all original rows.

temperature_coordinates.few_shot_rule: support indices floor(0.25*(n-1)) and floor(0.75*(n-1)); temperature-only, fixed without reference or roots

information_conditions.name: oracle_gap
information_conditions.rule: subtract target-relative error e(T0) as a phase-level constant from cristobalite

information_conditions.name: oracle_gap_slope
information_conditions.rule: subtract e(T0)+e_prime(T0)*(T-T0); e_prime from fixed 11-point centered least-squares slope over T0±5 K

information_conditions.name: few_shot_1_label
information_conditions.rule: fit a constant error correction from e at 1263 K

information_conditions.name: few_shot_2_label
information_conditions.rule: fit an affine error correction to e at 1263 and 2087 K

fair_support: For all primary condition comparisons, remove both predeclared few-shot coordinates (1263 and 2087 K); additionally exclude actually consumed labels when reporting few-shot metrics. Report full-support descriptive zero-shot/oracle separately.
reference_slope: Fixed centered least-squares linear slope over 11 consecutive points, T0-5 through T0+5 K. Sensitivity: 7-point and 21-point windows, reported without selection. Model slopes use the same fixed numerical operator for comparability; analytic/readout derivative may be retained as separate diagnostic.
phase_consistency: Apply each learned correction only to the held-out cristobalite phase in the shared quartz gauge; derive all pairs from phase-level energies to preserve cycle closure.
scoring: Reimplement and cross-check frozen P V2 tie/pair/envelope/event conventions. Keep all pairs, including no-root cases. Event matching tolerance 100 K; report exact roots and errors separately.
selection: No outer-target selection, calibration-coordinate selection, or tuning. C-simple and C-DPA archived checkpoints/configurations are frozen. No new training in S2.
seeds: Archived deterministic C readouts; seed not applicable.
units: Pair gaps: meV/atom; slopes: meV/atom/K; event temperatures: K.

figure_contract.core_claim: Separate the effect of phase-relative gap information from local relative-slope information on unseen-phase curve and boundary errors.

extension_rule: S1–S5 not part of S2 condition scoring. Keep C2221 admission independent; no new source phase is admitted without structure/reference contract closure.
